description: A tall clear tube with a red lid sits on the table, with a dark shirt lying off to the right and the lid soon set down nearby. The left hand steadies the tube as the right hand twists and lifts off the red lid, then picks up the shirt and pushes it down into the tube’s opening, packing it deeper with repeated downward presses before releasing; the right hand then retrieves the lid and places it back on top while the left hand continues holding the tube.
